common_rules: The judge sees only the case's frozen fixture, the system output and the cited source excerpts the case authorizes.
The judge may only answer the listed criteria; free-form grading is not accepted.
A malformed, partial or UNRESOLVED judgment is judge_invalid and blocks the case; it is never PASS.
The judge never sees or reproduces full source papers or original crops; the report carries IDs and locators only.
A human owner resolves any disputed label; evaluation agents cannot approve their own gold.

criteria.text: Every record the gold marks as expected is present with the approved schema class and required fields.
Each reported value equals the gold value after the owner-approved normalization (raw value, raw unit and normalized unit all agree).
Where the gold marks a value as absent from the source, the output leaves it absent and does not infer, default or fabricate it.
Every retained value cites a source Work/version and a locator that resolves to the quoted evidence.
No record or relation outside the approved classes/relations is emitted as accepted.

open_questions_for_h3: Which Works and which gold records form the representative fixture set (the plan proposes about 12 Work families)?
Are acceptable alternative unit spellings and equivalent numeric forms listed per field, or does the deterministic normalizer decide?
Is a record-level miss a case FAIL, or are partially complete records allowed for a named subset of fields?
Which model/settings revision is evaluated, and what is the repeat policy for live extraction (declared before any run)?
rubrics.title: Extraction against an owner-approved gold record
rubrics.verdict_rule: PASS iff every criterion is met; otherwise FAIL

criteria.text: Every factual claim in the answer is supported by a cited evidence item or KG node that was retrieved for the turn.
Each citation token resolves to retrieved evidence within the eligible sources and active-paper scope.
Every numerical claim (value with unit or quantity) is entailed by a cited source excerpt; none is invented or rounded beyond the source.
A conceptual question with insufficient direct evidence follows the existing leeway/fallback behaviour and labels general explanation as such.
When evidence is absent the answer states that explicitly or offers the existing ingest/approval path; it does not forbid or force a refusal beyond the existing rules.
Exact quotations in the answer are verbatim and relevant, and are labelled as quotations only when verbatim.

open_questions_for_h3: Which gold questions (conceptual, numeric, off-topic, weak-retrieval) and which graphs/papers form the fixture set?
Is lexical source support (a screen already implemented) enough for numerical claims, or must entailment always be judged?
How are acceptable alternative phrasings and unit forms frozen per question?
Which provider/model judges, and is a second reviewer required for disputed verdicts?

criteria.text: The reported figure and panel match the gold figure/panel for the cited reading.
Reported coordinates or panel geometry fall inside the gold region (frame convention stated).
The scale bar, q-axis range and unit equal the source-supported gold, with any Angstrom/nm conversion done by the deterministic helper.
A reading the gold marks as ambiguous is withheld rather than reported.
The result carries panel locators and no image bytes, paths or URLs.

open_questions_for_h3: Which authorized papers and which figures/panels are in the gold set, and who labels them?
What coordinate tolerance (if any) defines 'inside the gold region'? The agent proposes none.
Are OCR-derived units ever acceptable, or only text-layer units (current implementation never believes OCR units)?
